nodes.name: Apollo: Company/Contact Lookup
nodes.notes: n8n has no built-in "Apollo" credential type (it never appears in the credential-type picker no matter what you search - that's not a setup mistake, Apollo.io just isn't a first-party n8n integration). Sends api_key as a plain body parameter instead, sourced from the APOLLO_API_KEY n8n Variable - the same pattern TAVILY_API_KEY/HUNTER_API_KEY/GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY already use (Settings/Overview -> Variables in n8n, not a credential). neverError is set so a missing/invalid key (e.g. "Api key required") doesn't kill the whole enrichment run: Normalize Enrichment (LLM) detects a non-data response and treats it as "no third-party data available" rather than crashing, so the lead still gets PATCHed (with null enrichment fields) and still proceeds to scoring.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify((() => { const m = $('GET Agent Prompt (enricher)').first().json.agent.model; const model = (!m || /nemotron|openrouter/i.test(m)) ? 'gemini-3.5-flash-lite' : m; const isGemma = /^gemma/i.test(model); const apolloRaw = $('Apollo: Company/Contact Lookup').first().json || {}; const apolloData = (apolloRaw.person || apolloRaw.organization) ? apolloRaw : {}; const body = { model, max_tokens: isGemma ? Math.max(1024, 4096) : 1024, messages: [{role:'system', content: $('GET Agent Prompt (enricher)').first().json.agent.systemPrompt}, {role:'user', content: JSON.stringify(apolloData)}] }; return body; })()) }}
